subject: [PATCH 1/2] mm: page_alloc: do not give all non-blocking requests reserve access

reviews.author: Matthew Wilcox
reviews.summary: Suggested a neater way to implement the access check using a single function may_access_reserves(). The patch author was open to the suggestion but expressed hesitation about introducing a new abstraction.

2026-09-21.patch_summary: The patch aims to narrow the exemption for non-blocking allocation requests accessing highatomic reserves, which includes GFP_NOWAIT and other sites clearing __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM. This is done by introducing a new condition that requires both ALLOC_NON_BLOCK and ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE flags to be set. The goal is to prevent squandering of reserves on requests that don't need it.
